about: A two-letter US state code after 'City, ' read as the state's name (DC/D.C. as 'D C'), and a ZIP or ZIP+4 after the state (code or spelled out) digit by digit, 0 as 'oh', a comma pause before the +4 (loop B169, BI-149). Codes that are also words (OR IN ME OK HI OH LA DE AL CO ID MA NE PA) stay when the context is conversational: after Yes/Fine/So/Hey and similar, before ? or !, after a word with no lowercase letter (a list of codes); OK/OH/HI/ME also need a ZIP, a period or the end, after a name of 4+ letters. Backseat Driver: backseat::pronunciation::ForSpeech / CityStates (libs/backseat/pronunciation_states.hpp). Shared with BookLyre (CROSS).
